caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large instructional headline introduces a training offer, with the central offer phrase contained in a broad lavender rough-display tag and a short scope line underneath.
visual_anatomy.layout: An upper offer-summary panel presents four inclusions; beneath it, a bordered four-week roadmap uses four large colour-coded learning cards with one visual specimen per module.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and offer line → what-is-included strip → upper-left week one → upper-right week two → lower-left week three → lower-right week four.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans promise, rough display accent, bold all-caps section headers, and compact bulleted curriculum copy with tool-name badges.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender dominates the offer summary and week four, pink identifies week one, aqua week two, and pale blue week three.
visual_anatomy.surface: White page, thin dark container borders, soft rounded cards, low shadow, simple Venn, mind-map, and form-field specimens, and a tiny moving circular marker at the outer edge.
visual_anatomy.modules: One offer block with four inclusions plus four curriculum-week cards, each tied to an illustrative mini-diagram or tool reference.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: the offer contents and learning sequence are visible together, while the two-by-two week arrangement prevents a long sales list.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled frames show a small dot traversing the outer course boundary while a new-cohort badge and some headings or card edges slide into view; the four-week plan itself remains stable and readable.
motion.motion_job: Give a course roadmap a light sense of progression without asking motion to supply its learning sequence or proof.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Decide whether a structured learning or implementation offer has a credible scope and sequence.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Show the enduring inclusion set before a finite, ordered sequence of modules, and give each module one concrete retrieval cue rather than a paragraph of promise language.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the sequence is real and the included outputs can be stated precisely; do not use a course roadmap to imply outcomes that have not been evidenced.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the course promise, offer inclusions, weekly curriculum, tool references, four-card layout, movement dot, rough title tag, colour allocation, or source motion.

claim_boundary.note: The asset depicts a commercial training offer and its claimed deliverables; no original post provenance or outcome evidence accompanies the numeric-ID caption association.
